title: Replication Data for: Governance Interactions Concerning Peri-Urban Lake Ecosystems

contacts.name: Alice Nikuze
contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: This dataset supports "Governance Interactions Concerning Peri-Urban Lake Ecosystems: A Systematic Literature Review". The review conceptualises governance actor interactions concerning peri-urban lake ecosystems using a PRISMA-based systematic literature search. Of 132 records retrieved, 105 remained after de-duplication, and 31 full texts were included in the final analysis. The dataset includes the search strategy and term matrix, database screening records, inclusion/exclusion criteria, keyword co-occurrence data, and the coding scheme used to derive four dominant discourses on governance actor interactions, enabling transparency and further research on peri-urban lake governance, environmental discourse analysis, and socio-ecological transformation.
